notes.title: Strongblade Update
notes.notes:
In this big update:
- Theater opening!
- November season "Pirate Island Treasure"! Lots of gifts and a chance to get a unique costume with a Golden Pass!
- Over 100 new levels!

notes.title: Strongblade Update - Dive into more challenges!
notes.notes:
- Added a new seasonal pass! Dive into more challenges on your adventure. 
- Fixed numerous bugs and optimized game performance for smoother and more responsive gameplay.
